conventions.physical_tensor: B = nabla_(a U_b) in rate units
conventions.source_rest_tensor: A(p)=0 and B_rest=diag(0,D), with D real symmetric 3x3 and fixed
conventions.boost: canonical rotation-free future boost from source axes to observer component axes
conventions.norm: positive Euclidean component norm; no Lorentz norm in inequalities
conventions.branch: gamma is the positive real square-root branch

common_mathematical_definitions: M3 := Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) Real; M4 := Matrix I4 I4 Real
dot3 x y := sum_i x_i*y_i; q beta := dot3 beta beta
spatialL beta i j := (if i=j then 1 else 0) + boostA beta * beta_i * beta_j
boost beta := [[gamma, gamma beta^T],[gamma beta, spatialL]] on I4
boostedB D beta := transpose(boost beta) * restB D * boost beta
sourceQuadratic D beta := dot3 beta (D.mulVec beta)
dipoleMap D beta i := -2 * boostedB D beta none (some i)
observerNull n none := -1; observerNull n (some i) := n_i
redshiftFromBoost beta n := -(boost beta *v observerNull n) none
exact_lean_target_signatures: theorem gamma_pos (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : 0 < gamma beta
theorem gamma_sq_mul_one_sub_q (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : gamma beta ^ 2 * (1 - q beta) = 1
theorem boostA_mul_q (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : boostA beta * q beta = gamma beta - 1
theorem boost_lorentz (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : Matrix.transpose (boost beta) * eta * boost beta = eta
theorem redshiftFromBoost_eq (beta n : V3) : redshiftFromBoost beta n = gamma beta * (1 - dot3 beta n)
theorem dipoleMap_exact (D : M3) (hD : forall i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) : dipoleMap D beta = fun i => -2 * gamma beta * (D.mulVec beta i + boostA beta * beta i * sourceQuadratic D beta)
